children: RightNow founder Jaber said GPU providers are now offering NVIDIA B300 access for $4.60 per hour without a usage commitment, down from $7.90 last month. According to ChainCatcher, Jaber, whose company is a project in Y Combinator's 2026 Fall batch, posted the comparison on his personal X account on November 2 (UTC+8). He also said major changes are coming soon, adding that AI had given everyone dessert before and that it is now time to eat vegetables.

title: RightNow Founder Jaber: NVIDIA B300 Hourly Rental Offers Drop to $4.60 From $7.90
